verdict.rationale: Adyen documents that cardholders can add Adyen-issued cards to Apple Pay and Google Pay. It tokenizes them as network tokens and sends network-token lifecycle webhooks, which establishes wallet support and implies cardholder-initiated (manual) provisioning. Nothing in the evidence covers in-app push provisioning, the Apple/Google entitlements process, or in-wallet card art; the iOS SDK pages cover only card-detail reveal and PIN change. Missing for 10: push provisioning SDK/API from the issuer's app, documented entitlements process, in-wallet card art configuration, explicit manual-provisioning documentation, independent corroboration.
